# Claim-element corpus manifests

The sampling and reference-freeze manifests are retained test inputs, copied
byte-for-byte from accepted pre-archive commit
`7e0288484841963d726c0ee69ac6dcf6688d32f9`. The complete originating packet is
retained in the
[goal archive](https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect-goals-archive/tree/f77d31261342f65d8d383ddedb153e898121a16d/goals/claim-element-antecedent-check).

The tests locate these manifests here and continue to verify the existing
domain corpus, quotas, source anchors, reference freeze and XML digests. No
manifest content, sample, expected result or reference digest changed. Keeping
executable inputs beside their consumers makes their ownership independent of
goal-packet retention.
